details: Bitcoin and other major cryptocurrencies have rebounded as investor risk appetite improved following signs of de-escalation between the United States and Iran. President Donald Trump's decision to cancel planned strikes against Iran and his statement that an agreement could be reached soon led to a reduction in geopolitical tensions. This development also caused oil prices to retreat, easing concerns about prolonged inflationary pressures, which is seen as positive for higher-risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: US-Iran Tensions Ease, Boosting Crypto Markets
